Hint.Empty: Enter a target value to see your odds.
Hint.Unsupported: Odds aren't available for this roll's formula.
Hint.FirstTarget: Odds against {name}, the first of {count} targets.

playerDisplay.Name: What players see
playerDisplay.Hint: How odds appear to players when they type in a target. The GM always sees exact odds.

useTargets.Name: Fill in AC from targeted tokens
useTargets.Hint: When a player makes an attack with a token targeted, use that creature's AC automatically. Players can still type their own number.

hideFilledValues.Name: Hide filled-in numbers from players
hideFilledValues.Hint: Applies to a target's AC and to DCs that come with a roll, like the DC on a spell's save button. Players see where the number came from but not the number itself. Matching D&D 5e hides a DC whenever its chat card hides it, and hides AC unless D&D 5e shows AC on attack rolls.

targetedDisplay.Name: What players see when a number is hidden
targetedDisplay.Hint: Exact percentages let players work out a hidden AC or DC. Brackets keep it vague.

likelyThreshold.Name: Likely starts at (%)
likelyThreshold.Hint: Odds at or above this percentage show as Likely.

riskyThreshold.Name: Risky starts at (%)
riskyThreshold.Hint: Odds at or above this percentage, but below Likely, show as Risky. Anything lower is a Long shot.

labelLikely.Name: Label for Likely
labelLikely.Hint: Rename this bracket to suit your table. Leave blank to use "Likely".

showOdds.Name: Show odds to me
showOdds.Hint: Turn this off to hide odds on your own screen. Only affects you.
